title: Tool truth: parallel, redacted, oversized, costed
desc: Two tools run in parallel and resolve out of order; a secret argument renders as a hold-to-reveal pill; an oversized result stays behind content_full_ref with a load-on-demand trace; and every turn ends with a quiet cost/latency/turns receipt.
why: The transcript is the audit log of what the agent did. Secrets ambient, sizes hidden, and costs invisible are three different lies of omission.
